Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

The FX test code has scale-aware canvas assertions, but the ticket specifically requires a generated studio CI lane at output scale 2 and a snapshot sharpness assertion. The recorded local studio gate was headless at its normal scale; it is not evidence that CI exercised 2x rendering. Add the scale-2 runner configuration in build.sbt/workflow generation and retain a one-device-pixel visual assertion plus the inherited perceptual-diff bound.

Evidence:
- studio/desktop/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/plot/CanvasPlotHostFxSuite.scala:53
